title: Best Places to Visit in Kufri: Complete Travel Guide from Shimla & Beyond
content:
Kufri - Himachal Pradesh,

Kufri is a charming hill station located just 16 km from Shimla in Himachal Pradesh. Often called the “Adventure Hub of Himachal,” it is famous for its snow-capped slopes, lush green landscapes, and thrilling outdoor activities. Imagine a place where children ride horses along pine trails, couples stroll in misty meadows, and adventure lovers ski or hike on scenic hills. That’s Kufri in a nutshell - a perfect blend of natural beauty, fun, and tranquility.

Originally a small village, Kufri has grown into a popular tourist spot, especially in winters when snow transforms the region into a winter wonderland. Its mild summers are also ideal for families looking to escape the heat of the plains. Despite being a small town, Kufri offers something for everyone: trekking, horse riding, skiing, photography, or simply enjoying the serene Himalayan vistas.

The town is very accessible from Shimla, making it perfect for a day trip or a weekend getaway. Whether you’re a history lover, adventure seeker, or someone who just wants to breathe in fresh mountain air, Kufri never disappoints. Its combination of natural beauty, adventure activities, and peaceful surroundings makes it a must-visit hill station near Shimla.

How to Reach Kufri:

  • By Road: Just 16 km from Shimla, accessible via taxis, private cars, and buses.
  • From Shimla Railway Station: Approximately 30 minutes by taxi.
  • By Air: Nearest airport is Jubbarhatti Airport (around 30 km).

Best Time to Visit Kufri:

  • Peak Season (December - February): Perfect for snow sports like skiing and snowboarding. Ideal for honeymooners and winter lovers.
  • Moderate Season (March - June): Pleasant weather for sightseeing, horse riding, and trekking. Best for families and day trips.
  • Low Season (July - September): Monsoon may cause road closures, so travel cautiously. Fewer tourists and lush green landscapes.

Distances from Key Cities:

  • Shimla to Kufri: 16 km (approx. 30 min by road),
  • Delhi to Kufri: 358 km (7 - 8 hrs by road),
  • Chandigarh to Kufri: 129 km (3 - 4 hrs by road),
  • Manali to Kufri: 264 km (approx. 8 hrs by road),
  • Kalka to Kufri: 112 km (5 - 6 hrs including toy train to Shimla + road),

Things to Do in Kufri:

  • Skiing & Snowboarding : Popular winter activity, with gentle slopes ideal for beginners and families.
  • Horse Riding : Children and adults can enjoy pony rides along scenic trails.
  • Himalayan Nature Park : Explore Himalayan flora and fauna, including rare species like the Himalayan Monal.
  • Trekking Trails : Short and moderate treks around Kufri provide breathtaking views of the Himalayan ranges.
  • Adventure Activities : Zip-lining, go-karting, and tobogganing are available for thrill-seekers.
  • Photography & Nature Walks : Capture panoramic views of snow-capped peaks and lush green valleys.

Top 5 Places to Visit Near Kufri (within 50 km):

1- Shimla (16 km) - Mall Road, The Ridge, Jakhoo Temple, Christ Church, Read more …

2- Chail (40 km) - Famous for the world’s highest cricket ground and peaceful forests.

3- Mashobra (20 km) - Apple orchards, quiet walks, and picnic spots.

4- Naldehra (25 km) - Scenic golf course and lush greenery.

5- Tattapani (50 km) - Hot springs and river rafting on Sutlej.
excerpt: Kufri, just 16 km from Shimla, is a picturesque hill station known for snow sports, horse riding, and serene Himalayan landscapes. This guide highlights the best time to visit, top attractions, nearby places, and essential travel tips for an unforgettable trip.

faqs.question: How far is Kufri from Shimla?
faqs.answer: Kufri is approximately 16-20 km from Shimla and can be reached in around 40 minutes by road.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Kufri?
faqs.answer: November to March is ideal for snowfall and winter sports, while April to June is perfect for pleasant weather and sightseeing.

faqs.question: Can we see snowfall in Kufri?
faqs.answer: Yes, snowfall is common during winter, especially from December to February.

faqs.question: Is Kufri suitable for families?
faqs.answer: Yes, Kufri is an excellent family destination with nature parks, adventure activities, amusement parks, and beautiful viewpoints.

faqs.question: What is Kufri famous for?
faqs.answer: Kufri is famous for snowfall, skiing, Mahasu Peak, Himalayan Nature Park, horse riding, and scenic Himalayan views.
